name: dracula-mods
description: Dracula-themed Claude Code mods: a live diff pane, Kubernetes, Docker, CodeBuild and worktree panes, a PR dashboard, AWS SSO status, guardrails for risky shell commands and small workflow helpers.

plugins.name: mod-manager
plugins.description: A Dracula-themed pane to install the Dracula mods and turn them on and off. Every other mod ships off; this one lists them all and remembers your choice across sessions.

plugins.name: live-diff
plugins.description: A Dracula-themed pane with the diff of every Edit and Write Claude makes in the session, a file navigator and line numbers.

plugins.name: kube-pane
plugins.description: A kubectl context chip above the prompt and a Dracula-themed pods pane: switch context for Claude's session without touching your kubeconfig, filter pods, and open a shell in any container from the app's Terminal.

plugins.name: pr-pane
plugins.description: Your open pull requests in a Dracula-themed pane: CI, Codex review and whether each one already reached your integration branch, plus a chip above the prompt that flags failing CI.

plugins.name: guardrails
plugins.description: Stops risky shell commands before they run: killing ports owned by Docker containers, printing secrets from the environment, rewriting your kubeconfig, and asks before kubectl writes on production contexts.

plugins.name: promote-branch
plugins.description: /promote previews merging the current branch into an integration branch (staging, homolog, develop); /promote go does a full merge in a temporary worktree and pushes it, never touching your checkout.

plugins.name: codex-loop
plugins.description: /codex-loop <PR> hands Claude a review loop with the Codex GitHub bot: request a review, weigh each finding, fix or 👎 it, reply, resolve and repeat until 👍.

plugins.name: turn-done
plugins.description: A toast and a chime when a long Claude turn finishes, so you can look away while it works.

plugins.name: aws-profile
plugins.description: Shows each AWS profile above the prompt with whether its login still works, a one-click `aws sso login` in the app's Terminal for the expired ones, and the AWS_PROFILE Claude Code runs with. Production profiles are red.

plugins.name: docker-pane
plugins.description: A Docker chip above the prompt and a Dracula-themed containers pane grouped by compose project: ports, health, Start/Stop/Restart by container name, logs and compose Recreate in the app's Terminal, and a warning when a container is older than your last git checkout.

plugins.name: deploy-watch
plugins.description: Watches AWS CodeBuild projects: a chip above the prompt with the last build, a warning when a push to the deploy branch started no build, and a pane with recent builds, their logs in the app's Terminal and a Start build button.

plugins.name: worktrees
plugins.description: A chip with your git worktrees and a pane that shows each one's branch, uncommitted changes and pull request, opens it in the app's Terminal and removes the clean ones whose branch is merged.

plugins.name: dot
plugins.description: An always-on assistant with a name and a face: give it goals, and it keeps working on them in background rounds, asks before risky actions, briefs you in the morning and pings you when it needs a decision.
